title: Leveling Strategies
content: Resting in an inn or a capital city builds rested experience, which doubles the experience from kills until it runs out. From level 15 the Dungeon Finder queues random dungeons, which pay well for leveling, and bind-to-account heirloom shoulders and chests add 10% experience each. The level cap is 80; Death Knights start at 55.

title: Gold Making Methods
content: Steady gold at 80 comes from daily quests, up to 25 a day, and from gathering: Saronite and Titanium ore, Frost Lotus and Lichbloom, and Frostweave Cloth always sell on the auction house. Crafters earn by selling glyphs, cut gems, flasks and enchanting materials like Infinite Dust.

title: Interface Customization
content: Interface Options in the Escape menu can turn on four extra action bars beside the main one, and Key Bindings lets you put any spell on any key. /macro opens the macro window, with 36 general macros shared by the account and 18 more per character.

title: Essential Addons
content: Popular 3.3.5 addons: Deadly Boss Mods or BigWigs for boss timers, Omen for threat, Recount or Skada for damage meters, QuestHelper or Carbonite for quest routes, Auctioneer or Auctionator for the auction house, Gatherer for herb and ore nodes, and Bartender4 for action bars. An addon has to be the 3.3.5 version (interface 30300); retail builds won't load. Each addon installs as its own folder in Interface\AddOns.

title: Server Types and Population
content: On a PvP realm, entering a contested zone flags you for PvP automatically, so enemy players can attack you anywhere outside your own faction's zones and sanctuaries. On a PvE realm you can only be attacked once you flag yourself with /pvp or attack an enemy player; the flag wears off five minutes after you turn it off.

title: Character Creation Tips
content: You can play ten races: Alliance humans, dwarves, gnomes, night elves and draenei; Horde orcs, trolls, tauren, undead and blood elves. Only night elves and tauren can be druids, shamans are orcs, trolls, tauren or draenei, and paladins are humans, dwarves, draenei or blood elves. A Death Knight unlocks once you have a level 55 character on the realm.

title: Gear Optimization
content: Gear is tuned with gems and enchants, including the off-hand. Head enchants are arcanums sold at Revered by factions like the Argent Crusade, Kirin Tor and Knights of the Ebon Blade; shoulder inscriptions come from the Sons of Hodir at Honored and Exalted; and a blacksmith's Eternal Belt Buckle adds one more socket to any belt.

title: Understanding Patches
content: The realm runs patch 3.3.5a, the final patch of Wrath of the Lich King. Patch 3.3 added Icecrown Citadel, the Forge of Souls, Pit of Saron and Halls of Reflection dungeons and the Dungeon Finder, and 3.3.5 added the Ruby Sanctum raid against Halion.

title: Achievement Collecting
content: The big meta achievements pay mounts: Glory of the Hero (heroic dungeon feats) gives the Red Proto-Drake, Glory of the Raider gives the Black Proto-Drake on 10-player and the Plagued Proto-Drake on 25, Glory of the Ulduar Raider gives the Rusted or Ironbound Proto-Drake, and What a Long, Strange Trip It's Been, for every holiday meta, gives the Violet Proto-Drake.

title: Managing Multiple Characters
content: You can have up to 10 characters on a realm and 50 across the account. Bind-to-account heirlooms can be mailed between your characters on the realm, and a Death Knight unlocks once one of them reaches level 55. Many players park a bank alt in a capital to hold materials and run auctions.

title: Endgame and Raids
content: At level 80 the endgame is heroic five-mans, raids, arenas, Wintergrasp, daily quests and reputation. The raids are Naxxramas, Obsidian Sanctum, Eye of Eternity, Vault of Archavon, Ulduar, Trial of the Crusader, Onyxia's Lair, Icecrown Citadel and Ruby Sanctum; Icecrown Citadel is the top tier and ends with the Lich King.

title: Learning the Basics
content: New characters start at level 1 in their race's starting zone. Class trainers in towns and capitals teach new spells and ranks every two levels for gold. Talent points start at level 10, riding at 20, and dual specialization at 40; the cap is 80.

title: Finding Groups for Content
content: The Dungeon Finder builds a group for five-man dungeons automatically, cross-realm. Raids aren't queued: they're formed in trade chat, the LookingForGroup channel or the Raid Browser, where you list yourself for a raid and leaders can invite you. Saying your role and gear level up front gets invites faster.

title: Managing Addons Effectively
content: Addons go in World of Warcraft\Interface\AddOns, one folder per addon, and are switched on per character from the AddOns button on the character select screen; tick Load out of date AddOns if one is flagged out of date. Their settings are saved in the WTF folder, so copying it backs up your setup, and /reload reloads the interface.

title: Questing Efficiently
content: Since patch 3.3 the world map and minimap show where each tracked quest's objectives are, so a quest addon is optional. The quest log holds 25 quests, and up to 25 daily quests can be completed per day. Picking up every quest in a hub before heading out saves the most travel.

title: Managing Inventory and Bags
content: Characters carry a backpack plus four bag slots; tailors make the 20-slot Frostweave Bag, and profession bags hold more but only their own material. The bank adds 28 slots and seven more bag slots bought with gold. Items have no weight, only slot count matters.

title: Reputation Grinding Strategies
content: In Northrend, wearing the tabard of the Argent Crusade, Kirin Tor, Knights of the Ebon Blade or Wyrmrest Accord in a level-80 dungeon sends that dungeon's reputation to the faction, called championing. Factions without a tabard, like the Sons of Hodir, rise only through quests and dailies, and humans gain 10% more reputation from Diplomacy.

title: Preparing for Raids
content: Raiders bring a flask, which lasts an hour and stays through death, plus food; a cook's Fish Feast feeds the whole raid at once. Repair before the first pull, and since raid lockouts reset once a week, check whether the group is on a fresh or a saved raid ID before joining.

title: PvP Preparation Tips
content: For PvP, wear gear with resilience, which cuts critical strikes and damage taken from players, and carry the PvP trinket: the Medallion of the Alliance or Medallion of the Horde. It breaks stuns, fears and other crowd control on a 2-minute cooldown; humans' Every Man for Himself does the same.
